text: Do not call a library sorting or selection function: `std::nth_element`, `std::sort`, `std::stable_sort`, `std::partial_sort`, `qsort`.

Find the k-th smallest element with a partition-based quickselect you wrote yourself: partition around a pivot and recurse or loop only on the side containing k. Sorting the entire array first (e.g. bubble sort, insertion sort, selection sort, merge sort, or inserting into a sorted structure) does not satisfy this constraint, whatever the function is called.
